suggested_fix: No fix required. The rebuild is serialized by xdp_state_lock. The coalesce buffer is allocated after ice_vsi_cfg_def() using the new num_q_vectors and is freed on every path. If ice_vsi_cfg_def() fails, the function jumps straight to unlock and does not call ice_vsi_decfg() a second time, so the already-released resources are not freed twice. Later failures do call ice_vsi_decfg() once.
